ios.desc:
Imagine being pulled from sleep or reminded, not by a jarring buzz, but by waves rolling onto shore, birdsong echoing through a forest, or a river flowing gently past mossy stones. That's the experience waiting for you every morning with the NatureCalls Reminder, Alarm & Timer app.

Alarms That Actually Feel Good  -  Choose from a stunning collection of nature sounds to greet your morning. Ocean waves, forest ambience, flowing rivers, and more — each paired with breathtaking nature photography that makes waking up something to look forward to.

Reminders You'll Never Miss  -  Stay on top of your day without the stress. Set reminders for any task, add lists or key details directly to each one, and let the call of nature nudge you at just the right moment - no more overlooked to-do's.

Timers for Every Moment  -  Countdown your workouts, time your cooking, or pace any part of your day — all with the same beautiful nature alerts keeping you on track.

Fully Flexible Scheduling - Set custom, standard, repeating, or snooze intervals to match your life. Automatically repeat on weekdays, weekends, or any schedule you choose. Your app works quietly in the background while you focus on what matters.

Why You'll Love It  - Most reminder apps feel like chores. This one feels like a breath of fresh air. Every alert is an opportunity to pause, reconnect with the natural world, and move through your day with a little more calm.

Offline support - when wifi is not available, NatureCalls is still there for you!

Nature is calling. Are you ready to listen?

quotes.text:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/naturecalls-alarm-reminder/id6760317840

Two things to call out: the first is it does not work if your phone is on do not disturb or silent/vibrate. He's aware of this and it's a permissions thing you need an exception for. He's applied for the exception but it's unlikely he'll get it because it's supposed to be for stuff that's like life or death. I think for his usage he's OK with that, and he has spent a lot of time working on it the past months so he just wanted to ship it at this point. The second is that it's obviously paid. I think that's fine if he had gotten the permission unblocked but I'd be a little hesitant to recommend buying it right now.
